column1: # Adaptive root cut-generator skip (CbcModel::setCutGeneratorAdaptiveSkip(),
# see CbcModel.cpp's serialCuts()) sweep configs for cutskip-sweep.
# Format: one config per line, tab-separated
#   <name>\t<comma-separated ENV=VAL overrides, or - for none>
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are skipped.
# "today" must always be present -- it is the baseline every other config
# is compared against (current shipped defaults: feature off).
# "proposed" is the winning config found by the Sep-2026 sweep (base vs.
# adaptive vs. adaptive-tN on both the full 442-instance mip-sanity-data
# set and the 176-instance hard subset): simply turning the feature on
# with its own tuned defaults (MIN_TRIES=3, MISS_THRESHOLD=3,
# INITIAL_PERIOD=5, MAX_PERIOD=20, MIN_COLS=500) beat every other
# miss-threshold tried (2/4/5) on every metric (dual/primal gap closed,
# bbTime, dual/primal efficiency) -- see cutskip-sweep's summary output
# or ROOT-FIXTURES.md for the full numbers. Listed first so it's the
# first thing tried.
proposed
today
# Alternate miss-threshold values already tried and confirmed worse than
# the tuned default (3) on the 176-instance hard set -- kept here for
# convenience if the binary/instance set changes enough to warrant a
# re-check, not because they're expected to win.
miss_threshold_2
miss_threshold_4
miss_threshold_5
